products.name: Model Y All-Weather Interior Liners
products.summary: Front, rear and trunk liners moulded to the Model Y floor pan.
products.description: Laser-measured thermoplastic liners covering the front footwells, rear footwells and rear trunk. Raised outer lip contains spills and debris. Removable for rinsing. Fits all Model Y build years from 2020 onward.
products.fitNotes: Fits 5-seat and 7-seat configurations. Third-row liners sold separately.

products.name: Model 3 All-Weather Interior Liners
products.summary: Front, rear and trunk liners moulded to the Model 3 floor pan.
products.description: Laser-measured thermoplastic liners covering the front footwells, rear footwells and rear trunk. Raised outer lip contains spills and debris. Removable for rinsing.
products.fitNotes: Confirm build year with the customer. 2024 refresh uses the same liner set.

products.name: Model S All-Weather Interior Liners
products.summary: Full interior liner set for Model S.
products.description: Moulded thermoplastic liners for the front footwells, rear footwells, front trunk and rear trunk. Raised outer lip contains spills and debris.

products.name: Model X All-Weather Interior Liners
products.summary: Full interior liner set for Model X.
products.description: Moulded thermoplastic liners for the front footwells, second row, third row and rear trunk. Raised outer lip contains spills and debris.
products.fitNotes: Six-seat and seven-seat layouts use different second-row pieces. Confirm before sale.

products.name: Model Y Glass Roof Sunshade
products.summary: Two-piece mesh sunshade for the fixed glass roof.
products.description: Reduces cabin heat load and direct sunlight through the panoramic glass roof. Installs into the existing roof channel without tools. Folds for storage under the trunk floor.

products.name: Model 3 Glass Roof Sunshade
products.summary: Two-piece mesh sunshade for the fixed glass roof.
products.description: Reduces cabin heat load and direct sunlight through the panoramic glass roof. Installs into the existing roof channel without tools. Folds for storage.

products.name: Model Y Pet Liner
products.summary: Rear seat and cargo liner for transporting animals.
products.description: Water-resistant quilted liner covering the rear bench and cargo area with the seats folded. Anchors to the rear headrests and cargo hooks. Machine washable.

products.name: Wireless Phone Dock
products.summary: 15 W wireless charging dock for the centre console.
products.description: Drop-in wireless charging dock that replaces the standard console tray. Charges two devices at up to 15 W each. Powered from the existing console USB-C connector.
products.fitNotes: Not compatible with the 2024 Model 3 refresh console.

products.name: Model Y Cargo Liner
products.summary: Moulded rear cargo liner with raised edges.
products.description: Covers the rear cargo floor and sub-trunk lid. Raised perimeter contains up to two litres of liquid. Fits with the load floor in either position.

products.name: Model 3 Trunk Mat
products.summary: Moulded rear trunk mat with raised edges.
products.description: Covers the rear trunk floor with a raised perimeter to contain spills. Removable for rinsing.

products.name: Cybertruck Bed Liner Mat
products.summary: Textured mat for the Cybertruck vault floor.
products.description: Heavy-gauge textured mat that protects the vault floor and reduces load shift. Cut around the existing tie-down points and drain plugs.

products.name: Mobile Connector Bundle
products.summary: 20 ft mobile connector with two adapters.
products.description: Portable charging cable supplied with the NEMA 5-15 and NEMA 14-50 adapters and a storage bag. Delivers up to 32 A on a 14-50 outlet.

products.name: Wall Connector
products.summary: Hardwired home charger with a 24 ft cable.
products.description: Wi-Fi connected hardwired charger delivering up to 44 miles of range per hour on a 60 A circuit. Indoor and outdoor rated. Requires a licensed electrician for installation.
products.fitNotes: Installation is not included. Refer the customer to the certified installer list.

products.name: J1772 Charging Adapter
products.summary: Adapter for public J1772 charging stations.
products.description: Connects the vehicle charge port to any J1772 station at up to 80 A. Stores in the front trunk or glovebox.

products.name: CCS Combo 1 Adapter
products.summary: DC fast charging adapter for CCS networks.
products.description: Enables DC fast charging at CCS Combo 1 stations at up to 250 kW. Requires a compatible vehicle and current firmware.
products.fitNotes: Check vehicle retrofit eligibility in the service portal before selling.

products.name: Model Y Roof Rack
products.summary: Removable crossbar system rated to 165 lb.
products.description: Aluminium crossbars that mount to the reinforced roof points. Supports Tesla and third-party T-slot accessories. Torque wrench supplied.
products.fitNotes: Reduces range at highway speed. Advise the customer to remove when not in use.

products.name: Model Y Mud Flap Kit
products.summary: Front and rear mud flaps, no drilling required.
products.description: Moulded flaps that mount to the existing wheel arch fasteners. Reduces paint chipping and underbody spray. Set of four with fixings.

products.name: Model 3 Mud Flap Kit
products.summary: Front and rear mud flaps, no drilling required.
products.description: Moulded flaps that mount to the existing wheel arch fasteners. Reduces paint chipping and underbody spray. Set of four with fixings.

products.name: Cybertruck Vault Cover Accessory Kit
products.summary: Rail and tie-down kit for the powered vault cover.
products.description: Adds four load-rated tie-down points and a cargo divider rail to the vault. Compatible with the powered tonneau cover in all positions.

products.name: Model 3 Sport Pedal Set
products.summary: Discontinued. Do not order.
products.description: Machined aluminium pedal covers. This product has been discontinued and is retained for historical lookup only.

products.name: Model Y 19" Gemini Aero Covers
products.summary: Set of four aerodynamic wheel covers.
products.description: Snap-on covers for 19 inch Gemini wheels that improve highway efficiency. Sold as a set of four with a removal tool.
products.fitNotes: 19 inch Gemini wheels only. Does not fit 20 or 21 inch wheels.

products.name: Model 3 18" Aero Covers
products.summary: Set of four aerodynamic wheel covers.
products.description: Snap-on covers for 18 inch Aero wheels that improve highway efficiency. Sold as a set of four with a removal tool.

products.name: Tyre Repair Kit
products.summary: Compressor and sealant for temporary repairs.
products.description: 12 V compressor with an integrated sealant canister for temporary roadside repair of tread punctures. Stores in the front trunk.

products.name: Vehicle Care Wash Kit
products.summary: Complete wash kit with bucket, mitt and shampoo.
products.description: Includes grit-guard bucket, wash mitt, drying towel, pH-neutral shampoo and glass cleaner. Safe for all Tesla paint finishes.

products.name: Wheel Cleaner & Brush Set
products.summary: Acid-free wheel cleaner with detailing brushes.
products.description: Acid-free cleaner safe for painted, machined and powder-coated wheels, supplied with a barrel brush and two detail brushes.

products.name: Paint Repair Kit
products.summary: Touch-up pen and applicator set.
products.description: Colour-matched touch-up paint with a fine applicator pen, abrasive pad and clear coat. Specify the vehicle paint code at the point of sale.
products.fitNotes: Confirm the paint code from the vehicle door jamb label before handover.

products.name: Model Y Centre Console Organiser
products.summary: Removable tray set for the centre console bin.
products.description: Two-piece tray that divides the console bin into a coin well, a cable channel and a card slot. Lifts out for cleaning. Not yet released - do not sell.
products.fitNotes: Release date not confirmed. Staging only.

products.name: Cybertruck Side Step Bars
products.summary: Fixed side steps for the Cybertruck.
products.description: Load-rated aluminium side steps that mount to the existing underbody points. Installation by a service centre. Not yet released - do not sell.
products.fitNotes: Requires service centre installation. Staging only.
